 · 27 October 2026 
 City v PSG: Be there early to enjoy plenty of Champions League festivities! 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article 
 Women's Team
 City contingent honoured at 2026 Women's Ballon d'Or
 OneFootball Videos
 Andrée Jeglertz’s side remain undefeated in the League Phase, and on Thursday 29 October, the squad will be looking to earn our first win in the competition this term as two of the best teams in Europe meet for the first time.
 Kick-off at the Joie is set for 20:00 (UK), but we would like to encourage fans to arrive as early as possible for the chance to be involved in some unique and unforgettable matchday experiences.
 CITY V PSG: GET YOUR TICKETS HERE! 
 Gates for the Joie open at 18.30, with a range of food and drink on offer, catering to all dietary requirements and tastes that best suit your matchday experience.
 Fans will also have the opportunity to be a flag-bearer on the pitch as we welcome our City and PSG onto the pitch. All you need to do is arrive as early as possible and meet with one of our Playmakers under the Jumbo screen.
 This opportunity is a first-come-first-serve experience as there is only 11 spaces available
 Ahead of kick-off, you can then take part in our City quiz with the top three fans to receive incredible prizes such as signed shirts, tickets to upcoming matches and more!
 And for fans over the age of 18, you can enjoy an alcoholic drink in your seat before and during the game, making matchdays at the Joie even more unique.
 We can’t wait to welcome you to the Joie on Thursday evening! And if you don’t already have tickets to the game, you can still get yours below!
 Don’t miss our UWCL home matches!
 After an entertaining draw with Real Madrid, the UEFA Women’s Champions League returns to the Joie Stadium soon when Paris Saint-Germain come to town!
 We’ll be going up against the French giants on Thursday 29 October at 20:00.
 Tickets are on sale now from just £10 , so make sure you grab yours as soon as possible!
 Get your tickets now!
